---
title: "Manager manual"
---

This manual covers Admin, the part of the shop app that only managers can
open: verifying paperwork, second looks at hand checks, and reviewing
changes. It is written for every manager.

Managers use the same everyday screens as groomers. The [Groomer
manual](../groomer/index.qmd) applies to managers as well.

Each procedure is numbered and follows the same order: Purpose, Applies to,
Before you begin, Procedure, Result, and If something goes wrong. Carry out
the steps in order.

::: {.callout-note}
## Click or tap
This manual says **click**. On a tablet, tap wherever it says click.
:::

## Procedures in this manual

| Number | Procedure |
|---|---|
| MGR-01 | [Sign in to your profile](signing-in.qmd) |
| MGR-02 | [Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd) |
